doc.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023

title: Ed Sullivan Show with Woody Herman: 'My Favorite Things'
summary: The band played live on the Ed Sullivan Show with Ronnie Zito replacing Jake Hanna on drums.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: And Ronnie Zito came in, took his place. He did a great job but he was not a Jake Hanna you know. He learned actually. We did an Ed Sullivan Show with him playing my favorite [scats].

Yeah. We did that live on the Ed Sullivan Show and they set us up in a straight line about nine to ten feet above Nat Pierce piano, Ronnie Zito drums, and Charlie “The Arm” bass, who always played acoustic without an amp. Yeah. You know it. And it worked you know.
I was anticipating a train wreck actually.
